svg.title: solver.py architecture
svg.desc: Diagram showing solver.py as the exact DFS branch-and-bound orchestrator, covering instrumentation, reductions, BBNode, persistence tracking, and the main search loop
svg.text: guarantees optimal solution while structural signals guide and accelerate search

g.text: Root LP → MWUA snapshot → DFS Branch-and-Bound → Reductions + Persistence + Pseudo-costs → Optimality
Treats search as a measurable dynamical system.
Represents one search node. Stores trajectory information.
Updated lazily after child LP solves.
Structural signals guide — never replace — exact LP reasoning.
Solver remains fully exact. Optimality guaranteed.
Structure shapes trajectory, pseudo-backbone, residual collapse, and pruning patterns.
